answer: Each identity commits a hash of its own local random beacon - a nonce from its machine's entropy pool - before answering, then reveals it after close. Accounts revealing the same beacon collapse into one actor, their rewards merging into a single capped payout. A sybil farm scripted from one shared entropy source sees 1,000 clones collapse into 1 effective identity: one agent's reward against 1,000 hosting bills. The honest agent's pearl of entropy is unique by construction and clears at zero cost; a nebula of fakes becomes one dim mirror of a single identity.
